status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (pilot 2026-10-14): UE import of the Ancient Leshen look-dev run 20261014-h2-lookdev-r2 (profile ancient-leshen-h2-lookdev/2: generic h2_bake H2 figure of the bake run 20261014-h2-bake-r2 + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM; TeamAccent ribbon on the three crows 6.04 % of the figure, profile ancient-leshen-h2-lookdev-teamaccent-r2) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/AncientLeshen/Rig/SK_AncientLeshen_Skeleton. No weapon (WEAPON_HAND none, rig-contract AncientLeshen weapon_bone null): 16 bones, socket Weapon on hand.R (the claws, WEAPON_SOCKET_BONE of the asset card). MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker. Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r2 pass pair 8.1, evidence/acceptance/20261014-r2/final.json). Rev 2 (2026-10-14, pilot fix 3ed2d354): only axes.front_from_best_bound_fit true — the Leshen is front/back depth-symmetric within the 0.05 uu bounds tolerance (UE x [-12.7105, 12.6791]), so run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import matched the true map (front -Y -> +X, 0.0005 uu) and its mirror (-> -X, 0.0315 uu) and failed skeletal_bounds_match_build_front_unambiguous / front_axis_as_fbx_preset; independent live probe: skull-band centroid x +2.20 uu, snout to +7.33 uu (evidence/stage7a-20261014/front-probe.json). Re-import by references/ue-import-package.md §4.4 (assets of 20261014-h2ld-ue-import deleted by script) into run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r2. Rev 3 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-14, light mode by delegation): only ue.figure_parameters gain the hero-wide v1 knob Saturation 1.15 and the AN-32 Fix slot A on MatID class 0 (legacy_bake = deer skull, antlers, pale claws: the LUT cannot reach class 0, it takes the v1 path) FixClassA 0 / FixGainA 1.1 / FixSpecA 0. Reason: review r1 (wood anchor) bone (scratch measure on the beauty frames, bone-measure-r1.json: the tool decodes class 0 only on the claws over the floor) Y ratio 0.60 board / 0.79 reading, sat 0.18 / 0.25 against concept 0.367 (hue +3 deg); wood within both; crows board light. Re-import by §4.4 into run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r3. Rev 4 (UE look-dev r3, the last light-mode iteration): only Saturation 1.15 -> 1.22. Review r2 (wood anchor): wood within both exposures (reading sat +0.040), bone (bone-measure-r2.json) reading Y 0.929 / hue +6.9 within, sat -0.102 (tolerance 0.10), board Y 0.61 / sat -0.17; crows board light. Re-import by §4.4 into run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r4.
